analysis.title: The Bank Of Nvidia Just Lost Its Chairman: Mapping Every Circular AI Deal That Now Hangs On Colette Kress
key_insights: Nvidia announced Jensen Huang resigned effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO and keeps the CFO job. The stock fell more than 13% initially and closed about 4% lower. CoreWeave (CRWV) fell 11% the same day.

Nvidia ended July with $99B of equity investments, $108.5B of guarantees and $56B of AI-cloud buy-backs and third-party leases, before further checks to Meta, Hugging Face and Nscale. The equity book was roughly 13 times its level a year earlier.
The structure of the deals is repeated: Nvidia buys a stake, the recipient commits to Nvidia hardware, and the cash returns as GPU orders.

The 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26 lists $366B of future commitments, including $279B of supply and capacity purchases (up from $119B three months earlier). It also lists $56B of additional commitments and $108.5B of guarantees, totaling $530.5B. This excludes the $99B equity book and recent deals.

The Ohio campus guarantee for OpenAI was capped at $105B in the final 8-K, after the WSJ reports Kress cut the initial commitment in half. Nvidia's CFO commentary says each generation deployed there could mean about 1.5 million GPUs, or $150B-$200B of Nvidia revenue.

Huang's August pledge to backstop up to $125B (25%) of a $500B financing platform with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman and KKR has produced no deals in three months. Bloomberg reports the earliest announcement is likely January and that customers have pushed Nvidia to go above 25%, since Broadcom offers more.
Broadcom backstopped $30B of a $35B debt deal for Anthropic's TPUs in May and is backstopping about 72.5% ($43B) of a second $63B Anthropic deal.

Goldman's James Schneider kept Buy and cut the target to $220 from $300. He expects Nvidia to honor announced commitments but says new multi-party investments at the same scale will be harder without Huang.

UBS's Tim Arcuri says financing is the first key area of impact and expects a likely 'pause' in new deals. A pause could pull $50B or more out of the AI ecosystem, against Nvidia free cash flow of about $50-60B a quarter.
William Blair's Sebastien Naji downgraded to Market Perform. He says existing contracts survive but the next round of deals is at risk, which could open Nvidia to competition from Broadcom and AMD.

Raymond James's Sunaina Sinha Haldea (via CNBC) does not expect capital to leave but says lenders could want more pay for the uncertainty. Saxo's Charu Chanana calls this not yet a financing crisis but a possible catalyst for broader repricing of AI risk.

Nscale received $860M of rent guarantees for its Texas site and is reportedly negotiating more than $5B of Nvidia credit support for a West Virginia campus built for Anthropic. Lenders fund chip SPVs on the tenant's credit and GPU value, so an Nvidia guarantee drives the rating and price of the debt.

Per the WSJ, Huang called finance executives in August over guarantees to companies that could not afford Nvidia chips. Nvidia paused some revenue-share credit support deals in late August and began turning off the tap in October. Nvidia's average monthly P/E fell from 23 in May to 16 in October.

The first test is the Q3 report on Tuesday, Nov 17, where Kress is expected to be asked about the $500B platform. The author argues new backstops will get smaller, slower and more expensive, and that CCC spreads are already near cycle wides.

market_movers.rationale: Goldman's Schneider kept Buy and cut the target to $220 from $300 after the CEO announcement. He expects existing commitments to be honored but sees new large-scale ecosystem investments as harder without Huang.
William Blair's Naji downgraded to Market Perform. He says the risk is the next round of deals and Nvidia's ability to defend share into 2027, with Broadcom and AMD as competitors.
CoreWeave fell 11% while marketing a $4B+ investment-grade loan where Nvidia is presumed guarantor. Its euro bonds trade around 80 cents.
William Blair carries Outperform on Broadcom (AVGO $353.80) and names it a beneficiary if Nvidia is weakened.
William Blair carries Outperform on AMD (AMD $575.38) and names it a potential competitive beneficiary.

sector_views.rationale: They depend on Nvidia's funding and guarantees. A repriced or withdrawn backstop hits the weakest and most indebted borrowers first.

earnings_insights: Nvidia reports Q3 on Tuesday, Nov 17 (a date stated in the article, which is dated Nov 16). The author expects questions on the $500B financing platform. No EPS or revenue estimate is given.
Nvidia's average monthly P/E fell from 23 in May to 16 in October, per the WSJ, and the company responded with the largest buyback in its history.
risk_factors: Nvidia pauses or shrinks new guarantees and equity investments under interim CEO Kress, with a board search and a first-ever board chair pending.
Lenders demand higher compensation or larger backstops, widening spreads for borrowers that depend on Nvidia's balance sheet.
GPU residual value must hold for the life of the loans for the chip-backed financing model to work.
Neocloud utilization in the 75-85% range may not cover debt service before hardware is obsolete (Palihapitiya's bear case).
Supply commitments rose to $279B in three months while large cloud providers move toward alternative chips.
Customers may switch to Google or AMD chips now that Huang's possible reaction is no longer a constraint.
vol_and_positioning: CCC credit spreads are described as near cycle wides, which the author says makes it hard for neoclouds to refinance without Nvidia support.
geopolitical: The DOJ is looking at customers' shipments of Nvidia chips and House committee chairs want a closed-door briefing.
cross_bank_references: Goldman notes investor concern that AI infrastructure growth could slow without financing from Nvidia or its competitors.
UBS's Arcuri cites financing as the first of three key areas of impact, in line with the Goldman point.
William Blair cites Broadcom (AVGO) and AMD as potential competitors that gain if Nvidia weakens.

tension_points.bull_case: The 2027 order book is signed, Nvidia trades at a trough multiple (P/E 16 in October), and Goldman expects all announced commitments to be honored.
tension_points.bear_case: The order book was filled largely by customers Nvidia financed or backstopped. New deals at scale will be harder, slower and costlier without Huang, and lenders are asking for more than 25% backstops.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The Q3 report on Nov 17: a Kress answer that the $500B platform is not moving, or a platform deal announced by January, would decide the bear and bull cases.

theme_stances.key_argument: New large guarantees and investments will get smaller, slower and more expensive under an interim CEO with every reason to protect the balance sheet.
